City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JUNE 26, 2018
07:15
P.M.
6-26-18 Agenda
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Lewis, Holloway, Argudo, Munoz and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS â€“ None
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF JUNE 7 AND JUNE 12, 2018
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of June 7 and June 12, 2018.
A-1 Minutes 6-7-18 CC-SA
A-1 Minutes 6-12-18 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF PROPOSED ANNUAL SEWER LEVY REPORT FOR COLLECTION OF SEWER CHARGES AND ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION CONFIRMING SEWER CHARGES PURSUANT TO CHAPTER 4.10 OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018/2019
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and receive public input; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 18-5426 confirming the Fiscal Year 2018/2019 sewer charge pursuant to Chapter 4.10 of the La Puente Municipal Code.
B-1 Sewer Charge Capital FY 18-19 Staff Report
B-1 Sewer Charge Capital FY 18-19 Attachment A Resolution
B-2
CONSIDERATION OF PROPOSED ANNUAL SEWER LEVY REPORT FOR COLLECTION OF SEWER MAINTENANCE CHARGES AND ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION CONFIRMING SEWER MAINTENANCE CHARGES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018/2019
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and receive public input; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 18-5427 ordering the levy of the sewer maintenance charge for Fiscal Year 2018/2019.
B-2 Sewer Maintenance Levy FY 18-19 Staff Report
B-2 Sewer Maintenance Levy FY 18-19 Attachment A Resolution
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF RESOLUTIONS ADOPTING THE ANNUAL CITY BUDGET, AUTHORIZED POSITIONS AND APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018-19
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 18-5430 approving the Recommended Budget and Capital Improvement Program for Fiscal Year 2018-19; (2) approve the transfer of $334,000 from Unassigned Fund Balance to the Capital Improvements Fund to fund the Street Sign Replacement Program originally approved in FY 17-18 and carried over into FY 18-19; (3) adopt Resolution No. 18-5431, amending the Comprehensive Personnel System and Establishing the Number of Authorized Full-Time Positions and Monthly Salary Ranges for City Employees; (4) adopt Resolution No. 18-5432, amending the Comprehensive Personnel System and Establishing the Number of Authorized Part-Time Positions and Monthly Salary Ranges for City Employees; (5) adopt Resolution No. 18-5433 adopting the City's GANN Appropriation Limit for Fiscal Year 2018-19 and establishing controls on changes in appropriations for the various funds; and (6) direct the City Manager to make the appropriate modifications to the Budget and prepare the final budget document for Fiscal Year 2018-19.
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Staff Report
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Attachment A Budget Changes
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Attachment B Chart
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Attachment C Grants
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Attachment D Resolution Approving Budget
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Attachment E Resolution Full Time
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Attachment F Resolution Part Time
C-1 FY 18-19 Recommended Budget Attachment G Resolution GANN
FY 2018-19 Preliminary Budget
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1453
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 18-5428 approving Warrant Register No. 1453.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1453
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING A GRANT MANAGEMENT POLICY
It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution No. 18-5429 adopting a Grant Management Policy for the City of La Puente.
D-2 Grant Management Policy Staff Report
D-2 Grant Management Policy Resolution
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE AGREEMENT FOR ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT SERVICES WITH B.L. ELKINS FOR PROJECT SUPPORT SERVICES EXTENDING THE TERM UNTIL JUNE 30, 2018
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 2 to the Agreement for Administrative Support Services with B.L. Elkins extending the term until June 30, 2020; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
D-3 BL Elkins Admin Services Staff Report
D-3 BL Elkins Admin Services Attachment A Amendment
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND THE LOS ANGELES GATEWAY REGION INTEGRATED REGIONAL WATER MANAGEMENT JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY FOR COST SHARING FOR THE INTALLATION OF EQUIPMENT AND MONITORING PURSUANT TO THE HARBOR TOXIC POLLUTANTS TOTAL MAXIMUM DAILY LOAD
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Agreement between the Los Angeles Gateway Region Integrated Regional Water Management Joint Powers Authority; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-4 Harbor Toxics TMDL Staff Report
D-4 Harbor Toxics TMDL Attachment A Agreement
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH US BANK FOR BANKING SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Professional Services Agreement with US Bank; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement and all documents necessary to effectuate this action.
D-5 US Bank Banking Services Staff Report
D-5 US Bank Banking Services Attachment A Agreement
D-6
SECOND READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 18-957 AMENDING TITLE 4 (HEALTH AND SANITATION) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADD A NEW CHAPTER 4.13 (CONTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION WASTE RECYCLING PROGRAM), AND NOTICE OF EXEMPTION REGARDING SAME
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Ordinance No. 18-957, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Amending Title 4 (Health And Sanitation) of the La Puente Municipal Code to Add a New Chapter 4.13 (Construction And Demolition Waste Recycling Program); and (2) approve and adopt the Notice of Exemption.
D-6 Construction and Demolition Staff Report
D-6 Construction and Demolition Attachment A Ordinance
D-6 Construction and Demolition Attachment B NOE
C-1
CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF RESOLUTIONS ADOPTING THE ANNUAL CITY BUDGET, AUTHORIZED POSITIONS AND APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018-19
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 18-5430 approving the Recommended Budget and Capital Improvement Program for Fiscal Year 2018-19; (2) approve the transfer of $334,000 from Unassigned Fund Balance to the Capital Improvements Fund to fund the Street Sign Replacement Program originally approved in FY 17-18 and carried over into FY 18-19; (3) adopt Resolution No. 18-5431, amending the Comprehensive Personnel System and Establishing the Number of Authorized Full-Time Positions and Monthly Salary Ranges for City Employees; (4) adopt Resolution No. 18-5432, amending the Comprehensive Personnel System and Establishing the Number of Authorized Part-Time Positions and Monthly Salary Ranges for City Employees; (5) adopt Resolution No. 18-5433 adopting the City's GANN Appropriation Limit for Fiscal Year 2018-19 and establishing controls on changes in appropriations for the various funds; and (6) direct the City Manager to make the appropriate modifications to the Budget and prepare the final budget document for Fiscal Year 2018-19.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL - None

AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
